title: 1620 Prairie's windows, round-headed under their hoods as in 1874
items: The Robert Law house's two upper street windows, over the bay window and over the door, are now round-headed, as the 1874 engraving draws them, each under a stone hood with a key on its crown.
The north wall now has the engraving's two flat-headed windows a storey instead of three.
The hoods' form, the keys and every window's size are liberties.
